claims.claim_text: We have evaluated model M4 on our self-driving car by replacing the existing planner module with the learned model M4 and replicated the driving behaviors observed in simulation.
claims.normalized_text: Model M4 was evaluated on a self-driving car by replacing the existing planner module, replicating simulation driving behaviors.

claims.claim_text: The videos of several runs illustrate the smoothness of the network’s driving ability, its ability to deal with stop-signs and turns, and to drive for long durations in full closed-loop control without deviating from the trajectory.
claims.normalized_text: The network drives smoothly, handles stop-signs and turns, and maintains trajectory in long closed-loop control runs.

claims.claim_text: In an open-loop evaluation, test examples of expert driving data are used to compute the L2 distance error between predicted and ground-truth waypoints, without using predictions to drive the agent forward.
claims.normalized_text: Open-loop evaluation computes L2 distance error between predicted and ground-truth waypoints without closed-loop feedback.

claims.claim_text: Figure 8a shows the L2 distance metric in the open-loop evaluation setting for models M0 and M4 on a test set of 10,000 examples.
claims.normalized_text: Figure 8a presents L2 distance errors for models M0 and M4 on 10,000 test examples in open-loop evaluation.
